title: Sardine and greens rice
summary: Sardine and greens rice is a japanese dinner built around sardines in spring water and basmati rice, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Pat sardines in spring water dry and season it. Prep basmati rice and baby spinach for Sardine and greens rice so the pan is not waiting.
steps.tip: Dry protein browns. Wet protein steams and turns grey.

steps.instruction: Heat the oil and cook sardines in spring water on both sides until done. Lift it out to rest.
In the same pan, cook basmati rice and baby spinach in the leftover juices until tender. Add any lemon, mustard or herbs.
steps.tip: Taste Sardine and greens rice before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Slice sardines in spring water and serve it with the vegetables and pan juices.  Serve with the rice, simmered in salted water until tender.
